diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~219% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.189), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool1' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.6181. Series context: trend strength 0.888 and seasonal strength 0.165; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.189); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.574.
